tasks.label: Build stock ROM
tasks.detail: Reassembles the untouched reconstructions (NIR, NET, CC710). Each must stay byte-identical to its EPROM dump.
tasks.command: sjasmplus --fullpath --lst=cc784nir.lst cc784nir.asm && sjasmplus --fullpath --lst=cc784net.lst cc784net.asm && sjasmplus --fullpath --lst=cc710.lst cc710.asm

tasks.label: Verify stock ROM is byte-identical
tasks.detail: Regression test for any edit to src/stock: NIR c021af146a50b93a22d13535201b7eaa, NET 872c87932339e9e072c5525d30ffb5df, CC710 f346d39e5aa7b49709a717c85d7c7e11.
tasks.command: ok=1; for p in cc784nir:c021af146a50b93a22d13535201b7eaa cc784net:872c87932339e9e072c5525d30ffb5df cc710:f346d39e5aa7b49709a717c85d7c7e11; do f=${p%%:*}; h=${p##*:}; if test "$(md5 -q $f.bin)" = $h; then echo "OK: $f.bin byte-identical to the dump"; else echo "FAIL: $f.bin no longer matches the dump"; ok=0; fi; done; test $ok = 1

tasks.label: Diff stock vs patched source
tasks.detail: The diff is the changelog: everything outside the patches is kept identical on purpose.

tasks.label: M27C256 -- verify erased
tasks.detail: Blank check. Must pass before programming; if it fails, back under the UV lamp for another 15 min.

tasks.label: M27C256 -- program
tasks.detail: Writes the patched 32 K image and verifies. Requires a UV-erased chip.

tasks.label: Pack OTA image
tasks.detail: Fills the trailer page of the patched build (cc784nir_bank.bin, what push sends) and writes the 32 K chip image for the T48 (cc784nir_chip.bin: the same app in both banks, seq 1 and 0).

tasks.label: AT28C256-15PU -- program
tasks.detail: Burns the packed 32 K chip image (both banks). -u disables software data protection before writing, -P re-enables it after: with /WE on /WR, an unprotected chip gets written by any crash. Bodges per CC784_ota.md §2: pin 27 (/WE) to Z80 /WR with a 10 k pull-up, pin 22 (/OE) to Z80 /RD, pin 1 (A14) to the added '273's Q0.

tasks.label: Build patched ROM (CC710)
tasks.detail: The same source for the CC710's 59-column panel (-DCC710), on a CC784-3A board converted per CC784_hardware.md §12.

tasks.label: OTA: emulator regression
tasks.detail: EEPROM model self-test, boot stub scenarios, a full B5 update, the host tool's push, all against the emulated sign. fuzz [RUNS] is separate (slow).
tasks.command: uv run tools/cc784_sim.py eeprom && uv run tools/cc784_sim.py ota && uv run tools/cc784_sim.py update && uv run tools/cc784_sim.py push && uv run tools/cc784_sim.py ram && uv run tools/cc784_sim.py quiet && uv run tools/cc784_sim.py speed && uv run tools/cc784_sim.py baud && uv run tools/cc784_sim.py clock && uv run tools/cc784_sim.py config && uv run tools/cc784_sim.py keypad
